name: branding-red-visual-identity-logo-concept-and-portrait-notification
title: Red Logo Concept with Portrait Notification
whatItIs: A two-part board: a red vignette panel with a navy and red circle-and-bar mark and a wallet plus coins plus combination formula, and a red-lit portrait of a smiling woman with a frosted notification card showing the app icon.
whatItMeans: Showing the idea equation behind the mark gives it meaning, and the portrait shows the brand in an everyday moment.
techniques: Idea formula (wallet plus coins equals mark) beneath the logo
Two-circle mark in navy and red on a bar
Red-lit photography to match the brand
Frosted notification card with app icon
Two equal rounded panels side by side

vocabulary.definition: A plus-sign diagram showing which ideas combine into a logo.
A frosted card imitating a push notification.
A presentation split into a logo panel and a photo panel.
